scope: Only concepts used in AETC obs (as question concept_id or as value_coded answer). Unused AETC concepts are skipped.
base: MaHIS-core concepts are the target. Concept match: uuid, else the MaHIS name lookup the MaHIS app uses (exact case-insensitive name; first FULLY_SPECIFIED row, else first row).

how_to_use.questions: For each AETC obs: find its concept_id in questions[]; take conversions[<AETC value column>] and apply its rule; write the result into target_column (default: same column) with concept_id = target_id.
how_to_use.review_gate: Conversions are applied only where action = map, or reviewed = true after review. Questions with action = review and reviewed = false keep their AETC value column unchanged and are logged; action = unmapped questions are skipped and logged.
how_to_use.unmapped_values: Values that could not be converted are listed per concept (unmapped_values) and in full in concept_unmapped_values.csv; fill in the last column there to extend value_map.

rules.text_to_coded: look up value_text in value_map -> value_coded = target_id (value_text cleared); values not in value_map are logged (unmapped_values)
rules.text_to_numeric: numeric strings parsed; other labels via value_map -> value_numeric
rules.text_to_numeric_keep_other_text: numeric strings -> value_numeric; any other text stays in value_text (MaHIS AETC forms save this concept both ways)
rules.group_parent: obs with no value (obs_group parent); keep as group
rules.review: no automatic conversion; decide per concept

how_to_use.decision: The MaHIS concept datatype decides. Datatype N/A accepts any value: the AETC value is copied as-is into the same column. Only concepts with a real MaHIS datatype (here: Coded) are converted, e.g. AETC value_text -> value_coded via value_map. MaHIS form declarations and MaHIS-core obs rows are recorded (mahis_other_evidence_not_used) but not used.

mahis_storage_evidence.mahis_datatype_na: MaHIS datatype N/A; AETC value copied as-is
mahis_storage_evidence.mahis_concept_datatype: MaHIS concept datatype (Coded/Numeric/Text/Date) decides the column

how_to_use.unconverted_values: Values in unmapped_values stay in value_text and are logged, unless a value is filled in concept_unmapped_values.csv.
